title: Reverse Only Letters
summary: For a string s, reverse only the English letters while keeping non-letter characters in their original positions.
statement: For a string s, reverse only the English letters while keeping non-letter characters in their original positions. Return the modified string.
constraints: Every nonletter must remain at its original index.
hints: Nonletters are fixed barriers only in the output positions, not in letter order.
Use pointers to find the next letter from each side.
Skip nonletters; swap two letters; move both pointers.
Each swap places the next required reversed letters without touching fixed characters.
editorial: Each swap places the next required reversed letters without touching fixed characters.

tests.explanation: Letters reverse to dcba while the hyphen stays fixed: dc-ba.
